content.content: Licence check, applied by reading the recorded nodes; nothing runs. Read the dependent's recorded decision against each recorded prerequisite in turn. (1) No element of the dependent may contradict the prerequisite it is read against: fail, naming the element and the prerequisite it contradicts, if any element of the dependent forbids, reverses or substitutes an outcome that prerequisite fixes, or narrows the prerequisite by excepting a case the prerequisite covers. (2) The check presumes no element of the dependent and no particular prerequisite clause; which element is at issue is a finding named only in the check's output. It requires no wording, sentence order or vocabulary of the dependent, and invents no rule the prerequisites do not state. (3) A placeholder, empty or ref-less commitment in the dependent, or in a prerequisite the check is read against, leaves the check with no recorded subject: fail, naming the placeholder.
content.rationale: Both endpoints are commitments in words, so the evaluation checks non-violation and demands no observable. The prerequisites are inline: kwxutvpw is an inline prose behavioural decision (natural layer) and tqxvykwn is an inline EARS requirement sentence (structured layer); the dependent rusopkql is an inline prose decision (natural layer). The kwxutvpw use sits in the matrix's natural-to-natural gate cell (evals/natural-to-natural.md), whose check is the licence check: no element of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite, with the contradicting element named only in the check's output. The tqxvykwn use has no matrix cell (structured parent, natural child); it takes the documented default, the same gate form, and is flagged for a matrix entry. One criterion covers both uses because both are the same question asked of the same dependent text: does it contradict a prerequisite it was drawn against. Because the endpoints are words rather than artifacts, any behaviour probe or test of the dependent's effect would exceed the child's layer and presuppose a code-layer decision not recorded here; the criterion therefore stays a licence and non-contradiction check that survives rewriting the dependent without changing what it decides.
